truth: a check guards a write only when it names the written receiver and its result is used (a condition or
an assignment, not a bare statement); invoke(...) is a write; a requireTargetWrite defined in the file counts
only when its body checks a permission on its first parameter (one defined elsewhere is trusted by name).
